title: Vendor security review
summary: Create a vendor security assessment workflow for SOC 2 compliance — questionnaires, risk scoring, and approval.

parts.title: Create vendor assessment template
parts.guidance: Tailor the assessment to the vendor’s service, data access, integration and operational importance. Request evidence relevant to those risks and define what security, privacy, legal or continuity questions require specialist review. Set criteria for accepting evidence and deciding exceptions. The template should support a reasoned vendor decision without making a numeric score the purchasing authority.

execution.rationale: Draft a risk-specific vendor questionnaire and evidence criteria for specialist review.

parts.title: Send security questionnaires
parts.guidance: Send the questionnaire approved for this vendor and service to the verified contact. Explain what evidence is needed, where confidential reports should be delivered and the agreed response date. Provide enough context to answer accurately without disclosing unrelated internal information. Give the vendor a contact for clarifying the request.

execution.rationale: Email can deliver the approved questionnaire, secure return instructions and due date to the verified vendor contact.

parts.title: Vendors respond
parts.guidance: Check incoming reports and responses for the actual product, legal entity and relevant period. Follow up on missing evidence or ambiguous answers. Keep confidential material restricted and preserve the original response alongside clarifications. Assessment can proceed with omissions visible; distinguish verified evidence from conclusions still awaiting information.

execution.rationale: Review supplied vendor responses for scope and gaps and prepare follow-up questions while preserving original evidence.

parts.title: Score and assess responses
parts.guidance: Assess supplied evidence against planned data access, sensitivity and service dependency. Explain the practical effect of gaps and exclusions, getting specialist review for material privacy, security or contract issues. The accountable risk or business owner decides whether to proceed, require remediation or decline. Record conditions and responsibilities with that decision, while leaving independently derived product rankings unchanged.

execution.rationale: Assess supplied evidence against the planned access and service risks, presenting conditions for the accountable owner's decision.

parts.title: Log in Vanta
parts.guidance: Enter the vendor, assessed service, evidence period, conclusions and decision conditions in the chosen compliance system. Restrict report access and link outstanding remediation to responsible people. Preserve any documented score calculation and its underlying answers. The record should let procurement see the approved decision and security see what must be reassessed.

execution.rationale: Vanta's vendor profiles and document controls record assessment findings, evidence and access restrictions.

metadata.supportReason: Vanta API supports vendor tracking. Security questionnaire review requires human judgment.
